notes.title: ⚠️ Temporary Twitch Login Issue
notes.content: [p]Hi Sluggers,[/p][p]We’ve run into a temporary issue with our [b]Twitch authentication service[/b]. Everything was working fine this morning, but starting a few hours ago the [b]OAuth 2.0 service we rely on is being blocked by Belgian ISPs[/b].[/p][p]Because of this, some of you may currently experience problems connecting or authenticating with Twitch. We’re already working on switching to an alternative server to get everyone back online as soon as possible.[/p][p]In the meantime, the [b]Offline Mode is still available[/b], so you can continue slugging manually on stream without interruption.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and support 💜 We’ll post an update as soon as the fix is live.[/p][p]– The Stream Slugger Team[/p]

notes.title: Issue connecting Twitch
notes.content:
🚨 Twitch Connection Issue in Version 1.1.6 🚨
Hi Everyone,

We’ve identified an issue in version 1.1.6 that may occur when connecting to Twitch. This issue only happens if you connected to Twitch the previous day.

✅ Quick Fix: How to Connect to Twitch and Use Stream Slugger
Follow these steps to resolve the issue:

Disable the "Remember Me" toggle and click on Start Twitch.

Stream Slugger will not start but will delete the previous connection details.
Restart Stream Slugger.

You should now be able to connect to Twitch and use Stream Slugger as usual.

🛠️ We're Working on a Permanent Fix
We’re actively working on a solution, and the issue will be resolved in v1.1.7.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Kind regards,
Phil

notes.title: Stream Slugger v1.0.0 live
notes.content:
Stream Slugger v1.0.0 is live. We have completed the free Early Access phase.

The application has undergone more than 600 hours of testing and is stable during live streams, connected with Twitch.

In this build, we've added a feature where the Slugger transforms into a Boss! All you need to do is set the maximum number of bosses to 2 or more. When the Boss gets Sluggered, the attacker will become the next Boss.

Have fun!

Regards,
Phil.
